about: Parks that have a last-resort Protected Planet match (site ID from the POTA website URL, or a location match for the Nov 9 296-lead list) and no official agency outline on the layers we already hold. This file flags approximate candidates only: it stores no WDPA / Protected Planet geometry. Not used by the 2-fer bot or public park cards. Publication of approximate outlines is pending a licence decision.
citation: UNEP-WCMC and IUCN (2026), Protected Planet: The World Database on Protected Areas (WDPA), downloaded Nov 2026.
